data.description: Queries build-origin, enrollment, and runtime eligibility before exposing activation; for EnrollmentRequired, submits only a bounded ManagedLocalEnrollmentRequestV1 and receives EnrollmentPreparedV1; after canonical acknowledgement of explicit activation approval and complete disclosure, submits a baton bound to the fresh Supported capability generation, candidate and previous hashes, checkpoint, rollback point, and verification plan. The helper returns Unsupported before quiescence if any guarantee changed
data.technology: BootstrapProtocolPortV1 over one-shot OS-authenticated local IPC
